usage: Used for relief from menstrual pain and abdominal cramps.
dosage: Typically one tablet up to 3 times a day. Consult a healthcare professional.
warnings: Avoid alcohol.
Caution in patients with asthma or kidney problems.
Do not drive if feeling drowsy.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place away from light.

usage: Used to prevent nausea and vomiting caused by surgery, chemotherapy, or stomach upset.
dosage: Place one tablet on the tongue to dissolve. Follow doctor's prescription.
warnings: Inform doctor if you have heart rhythm issues.
Monitor for signs of serotonin syndrome if taking antidepressants.
storage: Keep in the blister pack until use.

usage: Prevents and treats nausea and vomiting.
dosage: Usually 1 tablet as needed or before treatment as directed. Consult a doctor.
warnings: Inform physician of any liver conditions.
Watch for severe allergic reactions.

genericName: Ferric Ammonium Citrate + Vitamin B12 + Folic Acid
usage: Used to treat and prevent iron deficiency anemia and vitamin B12 deficiency.
dosage: Adults: 1 tablespoonful twice daily after meals. Seek professional advice.
warnings: Do not take on an empty stomach.
Not for patients with iron overload disorders.
storage: Keep the bottle tightly closed in a cool place.

usage: Used for fast relief from severe headache and migraine.
dosage: Usually 1-2 tablets up to 3 times a day. Consult a doctor.
warnings: Limit intake of other caffeinated beverages.
Do not take more than directed due to risk of liver damage.

usage: Relieves pain and fever in conditions like acute pain and primary dysmenorrhea.
dosage: Usually 1 tablet twice daily after food. Seek physician's guidance.
warnings: Not for children under 12.
Use for the shortest duration possible to protect the liver.

usage: Relieves cough, congestion, and muscle aches caused by common colds.
dosage: Apply on chest, neck, and back. For adults and children above 2 years. Do not ingest.
warnings: External use only.
Do not heat or microwave.
Avoid use in nostrils or on damaged skin.
storage: Keep the lid tight. Store in a cool place.

usage: Used to treat parasitic worm infections.
dosage: Commonly a single dose for most infections. Chew or swallow with water. Follow doctor's orders.
warnings: Not recommended during pregnancy (can harm fetus).
Wait 1 month after treatment before conceiving.

usage: Pediatric medicine for fever and pain relief.
dosage: Dose based on child's weight. Usually thrice daily. Consult a pediatrician.
warnings: Give after food.
Do not use in children with asthma or heart disease without medical advice.

usage: Treats Vitamin D deficiency and helps in absorption of calcium for bone health.
dosage: Commonly 1 capsule once a week for 8 weeks or as directed. Consult a professional.
warnings: Do not take daily unless prescribed.
Monitor blood calcium levels if on long-term therapy.
storage: Store in a dark, dry place.

usage: Used to treat and prevent folate deficiency and anemia; essential during pregnancy.
dosage: Usually one tablet daily. Follow doctor's guidance.
warnings: Inform doctor if you have Vitamin B12 deficiency (pernicious anemia).
Maintain a balanced diet.

usage: Vitamin C supplement for immunity and treating scurvy.
dosage: One tablet daily to be chewed. Consult a professional.
warnings: Caution in patients with history of kidney stones.
Monitor blood sugar if diabetic.

usage: Antibiotic for respiratory, ear, and throat infections.
dosage: Commonly 1 tablet daily for 3 days. Complete the course. Consult a doctor.
warnings: Inform doctor of heart rhythm disorders.
Maintain adequate fluid intake.

usage: Medicated soap used for dry and sensitive skin to maintain moisture.
dosage: Use as a regular soap while bathing. Consult a dermatologist for skin issues.
warnings: Avoid contact with eyes.
Discontinue if rash or irritation develops.
storage: Keep in a cool and dry place.

usage: Antifungal powder for skin infections like athlete's foot and fungal rash.
dosage: Apply to the affected area 2-3 times daily. Keep area dry. Consult a doctor.
warnings: External use only.
Avoid inhalation.

usage: Triple combination for controlling high blood sugar in Type 2 diabetes.
dosage: One tablet before or with meals as prescribed. Consult a physician.
warnings: Strictly follow meal schedule to avoid low blood sugar.
Carry glucose powder.

usage: Combination bronchodilator for relief from severe asthma and COPD symptoms.
dosage: To be used with a nebulizer machine. Usually twice daily or as directed. Consult a doctor.
warnings: Inform doctor of glaucoma or heart problems.
Avoid contact with eyes during nebulization.
storage: Store in a cool place away from light.

usage: Saline spray to moisturize dry nasal passages and clear blocked nose.
dosage: 2-3 sprays in each nostril when needed. Safe for regular use. Consult a doctor for babies.
warnings: Clean the nozzle after each use.
Do not share with others to prevent infection.

usage: Used for treatment of acute diarrhea and loose motions.
dosage: Initial dose 2 capsules, then 1 after each loose stool. Max 4 per day for self-medication. Consult a professional.
warnings: Avoid in infectious diarrhea with fever or blood.
Not for small children without medical advice.

usage: Used for treatment of anxiety disorders and sleep issues.
dosage: Usually 1-3 times daily as prescribed. Follow doctor's instructions strictly.
warnings: High potential for addiction and habit-forming.
Do not stop suddenly.
Avoid alcohol completely.
storage: Store away from moisture and heat.

usage: Proton pump inhibitor used for acid reflux, ulcers, and GERD.
dosage: Usually one tablet daily in the morning before food. Consult a physician.
warnings: May increase risk of bone fractures with long-term use.
Monitor magnesium levels.

usage: Treats gastroesophageal reflux disease and stomach acidity.
dosage: One tablet daily on an empty stomach. Consult your doctor.
warnings: Inform doctor of any severe kidney or liver disease.
Caution in elderly patients.

usage: Used for allergic rhinitis, hay fever, and allergic asthma.
dosage: Usually one tablet daily in the evening. Follow physician's advice.
warnings: Avoid driving or operating heavy machinery.
Report any mood or behavior changes to your doctor.

usage: Combination medicine for relief from symptoms of allergic conditions.
dosage: Usually one tablet at bedtime. Consult a healthcare professional.
warnings: Consult doctor if pregnancy or breastfeeding.
Limit alcohol consumption.
storage: Keep in a dry place away from light.

usage: Used to treat nausea, vomiting, and vertigo (dizziness).
dosage: Usually 1 tablet 2-3 times daily as directed. Consult a physician.
warnings: Avoid in patients with glaucoma or Parkinson's.
Not for use in very small children.

usage: Used for treatment of Meniere's disease (dizziness and inner ear issues).
dosage: Usually 1 tablet 3 times daily as prescribed. Consult your doctor.
warnings: Inform doctor if you have stomach ulcers or asthma.
Complete the full course.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place.

usage: Used to lower high blood sugar in patients with Type 2 diabetes.
dosage: One tablet once or twice daily with food. Do not crush. Consult a doctor.
warnings: Check kidney function regularly.
Discontinue temporarily during imaging tests with contrast dye.

usage: Combination medicine for effective blood sugar control in Type 2 diabetes.
dosage: Usually one tablet twice daily with meals. Follow doctor's prescription.
warnings: Report any yellowing of eyes or skin (liver issues) to a doctor.
Monitor kidney function.

usage: Anticoagulant used to prevent and treat blood clots (DVT).
dosage: Administered subcutaneously (under the skin) as directed by your doctor.
warnings: High risk of bleeding; report any unusual bleeding immediately.
Rotate injection sites.

usage: Potent antibiotic used for serious bacterial infections of brain, lungs, and blood.
dosage: Usually given as an IV or IM injection by a healthcare professional.
warnings: Inform doctor of history of gallbladder issues.
Check for Cephalosporin allergy.
storage: Store the powder in a cool, dry place. Protect from light.

usage: Steroid used for inflammation, allergies, and autoimmune disorders.
dosage: Varies based on condition. Take after food. Follow doctor's tapering schedule strictly.
warnings: Do not stop taking suddenly.
Inform doctor of any infections.
Increases blood sugar levels.

usage: Steroid for treating severe allergic reactions and inflammatory conditions.
dosage: Commonly 4-48 mg daily as directed. Follow tapering schedule. Consult a physician.
warnings: May mask signs of infection.
Monitor blood pressure and eye pressure during long-term use.

usage: Corticosteroid used for joint pain, severe allergies, and skin diseases.
dosage: Given as an injection into muscle or joint by a professional.
warnings: Do not use if you have widespread fungal infection.
Avoid live vaccines while on this treatment.
storage: Protect from light. Do not freeze.

usage: Treats a wide range of inflammatory and allergic conditions.
dosage: As prescribed by your doctor. Take with food. Consult a professional.
warnings: May increase risk of stomach ulcers if taken with NSAIDs.
Monitor for bone density changes.
storage: Store in a dry place below 30°C.

usage: Treatment of allergic rhinitis with asthma symptoms.
dosage: Usually one tablet daily. Seek physician's guidance.
warnings: Inform doctor of any history of psychiatric issues.
Avoid alcohol.
storage: Keep in a cool, dry place.

usage: Used for prevention and treatment of allergic conditions and motion sickness.
dosage: Usually 1 tablet 2-3 times daily as needed. Consult your doctor.
warnings: Avoid driving due to heavy sedation.
Consult doctor if you have enlarged prostate or glaucoma.

usage: Treats allergic reactions, nausea, vomiting, and motion sickness.

Avoid alcohol.
May cause sensitivity to sunlight.

Inform doctor of kidney stones or chronic kidney disease.

usage: Local anesthetic used to numb the area during medical procedures or for pain relief.
dosage: Apply to the required area as directed by a healthcare professional.
warnings: Avoid accidental ingestion.
Discontinue if severe irritation or rash develops.

warnings: External use only.
Do not ingest.
Keep away from children and pets.

warnings: Must be taken with plenty of fluids.

Shake well if using liquid form.

usage: Treats various skin infections and inflammatory skin disorders.

Report any worsening of condition.

Consult doctor if throat pain persists for more than 2 days.

Shake well before use.

usage: Relieves acidity, heartburn, and gas symptoms.

Consult doctor if symptoms persist.
